description: This file contains selector functions for accessing and computing application-related state in a Redux store for Mattermost, including enabling flags, app bindings, and command forms.

methods.name: appsPluginIsEnabled
methods.description: Selector to check if the apps plugin is enabled in the global state.

methods.name: appsFeatureFlagEnabled
methods.description: Selector to determine if the feature flag for apps is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: appsEnabled
methods.description: Selector to determine if apps are enabled based on feature flag and plugin status.

methods.name: appBarEnabled
methods.description: Selector to check if the app bar is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: makeAppBindingsSelector
methods.description: Factory function to create a selector for app bindings at a specific location.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderAppBindings
methods.description: Selector to get app bindings for the channel header if the app bar is enabled.

methods.name: getAppBarAppBindings
methods.description: Selector to get app bindings for the app bar, including backwards compatibility bindings.

methods.name: makeRHSAppBindingSelector
methods.description: Factory function to create a selector for RHS app bindings at a specific location.

methods.name: getAppCommandForm
methods.description: Selector to get the command form for a given location in the main app bindings.

methods.name: getAppRHSCommandForm
methods.description: Selector to get the command form for a given location in the RHS app bindings.
